title: Long words

summary_es.en: Break long words into syllables and keep the stress in place.
summary_es.fr: Découpez les mots longs en syllabes et gardez l’accent à sa place.
summary_es.zh: 把长词拆成音节，并把重音放对位置。
summary_es.ja: 長い語は音節に分け、強勢の位置を守ります。

tip_es: Long words become easy when you split them into syllables and find the stressed one first: ex-tra-or-di-na-ria-men-te (stress on “men”). Say them slowly in syllables and then speed up without losing the stress. Adverbs in -mente have two stresses.
